polaris: Can a real same-sample or matched-specimen nickelate packet supply P_oe + B_min before superconducting-output reveal, strongly enough to kill or preserve R_oe?

framework.physics_frame: Normal-state bilayer response metrology: construct an odd/even susceptibility observable from qz/polarization/form-factor-resolved spin/orbital scattering, then regress it only against independently measured non-superconducting baselines.
framework.core_observable: P_oe = signed, calibrated contrast between odd and even bilayer susceptibility channels on a frozen q, omega, T, pressure grid.
framework.identification_rule: All P_oe and B_min rows must be frozen before superconducting-output reveal. Tc, zero resistance, Meissner response, gap, critical current, and resonance labels are sealed until residual testing.
framework.strongest_route_summary: Use a matched-wafer/same-boule La3Ni2O7 packet: non-destructive composition/structure/optical/XAS/Raman baselines on sibling pieces, qz-resolved RIXS or neutron/RIXS hybrid for P_oe on the spectroscopy piece, and independent pressure-row replication in diamond-anvil or cubic-anvil environments. Existing literature supplies components, not the complete packet.

findings.main: The strongest feasible route is a new coordinated campaign rather than retrospective assembly. Existing work already supplies the individual metrology languages: RIXS/XAS detects electronic and magnetic excitations in La3Ni2O7; theory predicts separable even/odd bilayer spin response signatures; oxygen vacancies and ligand holes are directly imageable; optical and magnetotransport baselines exist; high-pressure Raman/XRD can locate structural rows. What is missing is not a new principle but a leakage-clean row architecture that binds these blocks to same-sample or matched-specimen identities before superconducting labels are opened.

supporting_sources.reference: Chen et al., Nature Communications 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-53863-5
supporting_sources.use: RIXS/XAS precedent for La3Ni2O7 electronic and magnetic excitation extraction; supports normal-state spectroscopy block but does not by itself provide full qz odd/even packet.

supporting_sources.reference: Boetzel et al., Physical Review B 109 L180502, DOI 10.1103/physrevb.109.l180502
supporting_sources.use: Defines why bilayer even and odd spin susceptibility channels carry discriminating information; supplies measurement targets for RIXS or inelastic neutron scattering.
Direct oxygen-vacancy and ligand-hole visualization; strong candidate block for non-tautological B_min.

supporting_sources.reference: Liu et al., Nature Communications 2024, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-52001-5
supporting_sources.use: Optical/electronic-correlation and partial-gap baseline useful as ordinary normal-state covariates, with superconducting-output features excluded.

supporting_sources.reference: Xie et al., Pressure-Induced Phase Transitions in Bilayer La3Ni2O7, DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-5326664/v1; ACS JPCC 2025 SI DOI 10.1021/acs.jpcc.5c07252.s001
supporting_sources.use: Pressure-dependent structural phase transition and resistance context; can anchor pressure path and lattice covariates but resistance-output labels must be sealed.
Raman plus first-principles pressure-phase tracking up to 32.7 GPa; useful for pressure-row structural state and denominator floor construction.
Review explicitly flags sample quality, oxygen deficiencies, and high-pressure measurement reliability as central open issues.

supporting_sources.reference: Lu et al., Communications Physics 2025, DOI 10.1038/s42005-025-02266-z
supporting_sources.use: Shows pressure and apical oxygen vacancies can strongly affect predicted superconducting properties; makes oxygen baseline mandatory, not optional.
High-pressure XAS/XES style local valence/spin-state control; candidate block for rare-earth 5d and Ni/O charge-transfer covariates.

findings.negative_search_result: No search hit showed an already published leakage-clean same-sample or matched-specimen dataset containing calibrated qz/polarization odd/even susceptibility plus full B_min before superconducting-output reveal.

feasible_packet_route.specimen_design: Grow one high-quality La3Ni2O7 batch, cut adjacent sibling specimens with tracked orientation, mass, dimensions, oxygen anneal history, and pressure-cell loading history. Reserve at least one spectroscopy specimen, one destructive microscopy specimen, one pressure-transport specimen with sealed labels, and one structural/XAS/Raman specimen per pressure row.
feasible_packet_route.same_sample_pressure_row: Best same-sample row is sequential non-destructive baseline -> pressure Raman/XRD/XAS -> qz-resolved RIXS if beamline/sample environment permits -> sealed superconducting-output measurement. If RIXS under target pressure is unavailable, use matched-specimen pressure rows with identical pressure medium, gasket geometry, ruby/diamond pressure calibration, loading date, and thermal cycle.
P_oe_sources: Primary: qz-resolved RIXS intensity maps on Ni L edge or O K edge, with polarization scans and incident-energy dependence sufficient to separate magnetic, orbital, and charge form factors.
Secondary: inelastic neutron scattering on co-aligned crystals where sample mass permits, used to cross-calibrate even/odd qz modulation and magnetic form factor.

Fallback: theory-constrained decomposition of RIXS maps using the Boetzel even/odd susceptibility channel definitions, but only if raw spectra and calibration files remain available for independent refit.

B_min_substitutes.measured_block: STEM/EELS, iodometric or TGA-style oxygen estimate where possible, O K-edge XAS pre-edge, apical oxygen vacancy maps on sacrificial sibling pieces.
single-crystal XRD or synchrotron powder XRD, Raman phonon markers, pressure-dependent lattice constants, octahedral tilt/rotation proxies, c-axis and Ni-O-Ni bond-angle proxies.
Ni L/K-edge XAS/XES, O K-edge ligand-hole pre-edge, La L-edge XAS, polarization-resolved XAS where geometry allows.

rocking-curve width, residual resistivity ratio as normal-state quality only, Raman linewidths, XRD mosaicity, STEM defect density, low-temperature normal-state magnetoresistance before output-label reveal.
pressure medium, pressure markers, load curve, unload curve, thermal cycle count, pressure gradient estimate, gasket/culet geometry, dwell time at pressure.

normal-state optical conductivity anisotropy or reflectivity/Kramers-Kronig Drude weight proxy, interlayer hopping proxy from ARPES/DFT-matched band splitting where available, excluding gap and superconducting coherence features.

calibration_controls: Use fluorescence/elastic-line normalization and a non-nickelate standard for RIXS intensity calibration; publish raw S_channel to chi_unit transformation.
Freeze q, omega, qz, polarization, temperature, pressure, and censoring grids before any residual call.
Define denominator floor as max(instrumental_noise_floor, bootstrap channel-mixing floor, blank-standard residual floor). Rows below floor are censored, not rescaled.
Use independent teams or locked scripts for B_min extraction and P_oe extraction; join only on anonymized row IDs.

Pre-register U_miss as fixed latent uncertainty buckets: unmeasured oxygen microtexture, pressure-gradient uncertainty, beam-damage uncertainty, matrix-element residual, and sibling-mismatch uncertainty.

Batch controls: same-boule sibling specimens plus one different-boule replicate; sample controls: intentionally oxygen-shifted or pressure-path-shifted specimens; probe controls: repeated calibration standards and blind duplicate spectra.
feasible_packet_route.output_blinding: Before residual call, forbid access to Tc, zero-resistance, Meissner/diamagnetic signal, superconducting gap, spin resonance interpreted as superconducting, critical current, or any human label trained from those outputs. Raw transport above the frozen normal-state window may be used only after censoring temperatures near any known transition window.

layout: 3 pressure states below/near/above structural transition or chosen pressure landmarks, each with 4 matched rows for pilot.
At least 2 independent growth batches in the preferred design.
At least 2 blinded duplicate rows whose specimen identity is hidden from the P_oe and B_min extractors.
At least 1 deliberately oxygen-shifted control and 1 deliberately pressure-path-shifted control per batch.
minimum_rows.row_definition: One row is a specimen or sibling-specimen bundle with frozen P_oe, frozen B_min, frozen U_miss, and sealed superconducting-output label.
minimum_rows.why_not_smaller: Below roughly 12 rows, denominator-floor censoring and sibling-mismatch uncertainty can dominate any cross-fitted residual test; below 2 batches, batch oxygen and growth-history confounds are indistinguishable from P_oe.

currently_missing_but_engineering: Published same-row qz-resolved odd/even susceptibility with raw calibration files.
Beamline-compatible high-pressure RIXS or a validated matched-pressure transfer design.
Pre-registered S_channel to chi_unit conversion and channel-mixing covariance.
Matched-sibling oxygen microtexture maps tied to spectroscopy row IDs.
A frozen pressure/thermal-path ledger shared across probes.
dangerous_if_missing: No independent oxygen/ligand-hole baseline: B_min becomes under-specified and pressure/oxygen confounding can masquerade as P_oe.
No denominator floor: odd/even ratios become unstable near zero channel contrast.
No sealed superconducting outputs: residual call is vulnerable to label leakage.
No batch replicate: same-boule idiosyncrasy can be misread as a physical effect.
No raw calibration archive: later reviewers cannot separate susceptibility from matrix-element artifacts.

phase_0_pre_registration: Freeze row schema, output embargo list, q/omega/qz/T/P grid, denominator-floor rule, U_miss buckets, and censoring rules.
Assign anonymized row IDs before measurements and store superconducting-output labels with a separate custodian.
phase_1_batch_and_baseline: Grow or source two La3Ni2O7 batches with documented oxygen anneal and phase purity.
Measure XRD/Raman/STEM-EELS/XAS/optical normal-state baselines on same or sibling pieces before any superconducting-output inspection.
phase_2_P_oe_metrology: Acquire RIXS maps at frozen qz and polarization settings; include elastic-line, fluorescence, and standard-sample calibrations.
Fit odd/even channels using a locked model with explicit matrix-element nuisance terms and bootstrap channel-mixing covariance.
phase_3_pressure_rows: Load matched specimens with identical pressure medium and geometry where same-sample multi-probe is impossible.
Record pressure gradient, load/unload sequence, thermal cycling, and Raman/XRD phase markers for each row.
phase_4_lock_and_reveal: Lock P_oe, B_min, U_miss, censored rows, denominator floor, and extraction logs.
Only then reveal superconducting-output labels for the residual-collapse protocol.

variables.epsilon_floor: pre-frozen denominator floor from standards, channel mixing, and noise

numerical_test.censoring_check: If abs(chi_odd)+abs(chi_even) < epsilon_floor, row is censored rather than amplified.

failure_modes.mode: P_oe cannot be separated from RIXS matrix elements or pressure-cell geometry.
failure_modes.classification: protocol failure if raw calibration and cross-probe validation are unavailable; engineering gap if standards and duplicate qz scans can bound it.

failure_modes.mode: Matched specimens diverge in oxygen vacancy texture or hidden phase fraction.
failure_modes.classification: protocol failure if no destructive sibling mapping or batch replicate exists; engineering gap if microtexture is measured and included in U_miss.

failure_modes.mode: Superconducting-output leakage through pressure row selection, resistance curves, Meissner imaging, gap spectroscopy, or human labels.
Denominator floor is chosen after seeing residual behavior.
Too few pressure/batch rows for cross-fitting after censoring.
failure_modes.classification: engineering gap for pilot; protocol failure for any claim beyond bounded feasibility.

failure_modes.mode: Pressure path is non-repeatable across probes and cannot be ledgered.
failure_modes.classification: protocol failure for matched-specimen design; same-sample design may survive if all needed non-output blocks are acquired before reveal.

failure_modes.mode: B_min includes a proxy trained on Tc, zero resistance, gap, Meissner, or resonance labels.

claims.statement: A complete published same-sample P_oe+B_min nickelate packet was not found in Round 1; the feasible route is a new coordinated near-future campaign.
assumptions: paper-search-mcp coverage is sufficient for Round 1 triage
unpublished beamline datasets are not counted as existing public packets

claims.statement: The P_oe block is physically targetable because bilayer odd/even magnetic susceptibility channels have explicit theory targets and La3Ni2O7 RIXS/XAS magnetic-excitation measurements already exist.
assumptions: RIXS or neutron geometry can sample enough qz contrast to constrain odd/even channel mixing
normal-state data are acquired before output reveal

claims.statement: Full B_min can be replaced by a measured covariate block spanning oxygen/ligand holes, structure/strain, local valence/orbitals, disorder, pressure path, and normal c-axis coherence.
assumptions: sibling specimens preserve enough shared growth and oxygen history for matched-row inference
destructive oxygen mapping can be assigned to a row without contaminating superconducting-output labels

claims.statement: The main gaps are engineering gaps until calibration, denominator floor, output blinding, and batch/matched controls fail; if any of those fail, the protocol fails rather than merely weakening.
assumptions: protocol success requires identifiability, not just high-quality component measurements

formula.units: dimensionless after chi_odd and chi_even are calibrated to identical susceptibility units

limit_checks.limit: chi_odd == chi_even and denominator above floor

limit_checks.expected: row censored by epsilon_floor rule, not interpreted as large contrast

inspector_check.direction: A route exists as a near-future measurement campaign, but current literature does not already validate R_oe or contain the complete packet.
inspector_check.data: paper-search-mcp was used for all four required Round 1 searches: core claim prior search, framework blind-spot search, counterexample/criticism search, and data-availability search. Targeted follow-up searches used paper-search-mcp for RIXS, odd/even theory, pressure Raman, oxygen/ligand-hole, optical, and review sources. No web_search downgrade was used.
assumptions: A/B independence maintained: current-CphiPacket/B and B outputs were not read.
Superconducting-output reveal is not part of this A Round 1 file.
R_oe is not claimed to exist.

deepening.next_layer_consequence: If the packet is executed, the decisive object is no longer a literature claim but a row-level leakage audit: P_oe must retain variance after B_min and U_miss are locked.
deepening.second_layer_consequence: If P_oe variance collapses into oxygen/pressure/structure covariates, that would kill the executable R_oe route without needing to argue against superconductivity itself.
deepening.most_fragile_premise: Matched-sibling specimens may not preserve oxygen microtexture and pressure-path equivalence tightly enough for row-level inference.
